angle: It builds the confidence interval entirely from a bootstrap percentile picture on twelve mouse weights and then reframes the interval as a visual significance test rather than deriving any z or t formula.
angle_detail: Start with [02:55]-[03:43] for the core definition of the 95 percent interval as the span covering most bootstrapped means, then continue to [04:04]-[06:37] for the visual-test use with the threshold-20 example and the two-group non-overlap caveat. If the resampling steps feel rushed, rewind to the refresher at [01:09]-[02:51] first, since the video assumes a prior bootstrap lesson and moves fast. Note the course-notation pitfall that significance is spoken as values outside the interval occurring rarely, so pair this with a formula video before the exam because nothing here derives or plugs in a critical value or standard error.
